profile.entities: Pritika Auto Industries Ltd (Parent); Pritika Engineering Components Ltd (Subsidiary); Meeta Casting (Subsidiary); Omnia Engineering Inc (US Subsidiary)
profile.subseg: Tractor Castings; Commercial Vehicle Castings; Railway Components (Emerging); LFC Technology
profile.themes: Capacity Expansion to 1L Ton; LFC Technology Scale-up; US Market Entry; Raw Material Pass-through

bull_bear.body: Disciplined approach: Debt-funded near-term expansion (keeping D/E <1); Equity raise considered for FY28 large LFC expansion; US subsidiary initial tranche $50k (total plan $100k) for market foothold; No dividend mentioned, focus on reinvestment.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Raw material volatility (steel, energy) and pass-through timing delays; Geopolitical disruptions impacting crude/chemical costs; Tractor demand cyclicality (monsoon dependence); Execution risk on large LFC capex; Litigation history on land acquisition (withdrawn from Hoshiarpur auction).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident on volume growth and technology shift (LFC); Transparent on Q4 margin headwinds (temporary); Aggressive on capacity targets (100k MT); Cautious on EV disruption (low near-term impact on tractor/CV); Pragmatic on funding (debt first, then equity).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: LFC technology allows modular capacity addition (500-1.5k MT blocks) at half the capex of conventional lines, enabling faster ROI; US entity strategy targets arbitrage of 300-500 bps higher EBITDA margins by bypassing Indian intermediaries; 60/40 legacy/new product mix creates a natural margin ramp as legacy items phase out.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Tractor segment (largest, ~60-70% of top customers) driving growth; CV segment volatile but supported by infra spend; Railway segment in qualification phase, revenue expected from FY27; Product mix shifting from small/medium to large castings (higher value/margin).
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Raw material cost volatility squeezing short-term margins | Escorts Kubota Ltd | beneficiary | Med | As a key customer (top 3), Pritika's ability to pass through costs ensures supply stability; Pritika's capacity expansion secures Escorts' large casting needs. |
| Need for cost-competitive large casting suppliers | Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd | beneficiary | High | Pritika is a top supplier; shift to high-value large castings and 15% volume growth aligns with M&M's tractor production targets. |
| Global foundry capacity constraints and high capex barriers | TAFE (Tractors and Farm Equipment Ltd) | beneficiary | Med | Pritika's overbooked status and capacity expansion provide TAFE with critical supply security in a tight market. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body: Q4 margin dip (12%) attributed to 4-6% raw material/freight/gas cost spike with 1-quarter pass-through lag; Legacy products (60% mix) have lower margins vs new components (40% mix); LFC offers 1-2% premium over conventional; Management expects return to 15-16% as costs stabilize and pass-through completes.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: ~15% CAGR for next 2-3 years (Target INR 600cr); Margin: Recovery to 15-16% EBITDA from Q1FY27 onwards; Order Inflow: Strong, fully booked; Capex: INR 25-30cr (FY27, debt-funded) for 7.8k MT; INR 60-70cr (FY28, debt+equity) for 20-24k MT LFC.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Fully booked/Overbooked; Estimated value >INR 600cr; LFC segment constitutes ~20% of current order book.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: 1) Capacity ramp to 100k MT via LFC (50% lower capex/ton vs conventional); 2) US entity (Omnia Eng) for direct exports targeting 18-20% margins vs 14-15% domestic; 3) New geographies (South Korea shipments started, Europe exploring); 4) Railway diversification.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Pritika Auto delivered record FY26 volumes (52.6k MT) and revenue (INR 483cr, +35% YoY) but faced transient Q4 margin compression (12% vs ~16% historical) due to raw material spikes; guidance points to 15% CAGR, margin recovery to 15-16%, and aggressive capacity expansion via cost-efficient LFC technology to hit 100k MT target.
